a.aria-label: 类比审计与可运输性 合同：Q37-I1 typed analogy-audit & transportability contract: analogy candidates (SURFACE_SIMILARITY / METAPHOR_ONLY / STRUCTURAL_ANALOGY / MECHANISM_CANDIDATE / TRANSPORTABILITY_CANDIDATE / COUNTERANALOGY), explicit mappings (entities, correspondence, cardinality, directionality, invariants, mismatches, omitted variables, hidden premises, scale/time/context differences, digest), mechanism evidence (distinct from shared form), transportability assessments (overlap, invariances, shifts, boundary, falsifier, uncertainty), and audit decisions with claim ceiling; fail-closed against metaphor/local-isomorphism/selective-correspondence/unaudited-structural-map/Q36-residual upgraded to mechanism identity, undeclared shift, residual-as-cause, mechanism upgrade, transportability without overlap/invariance/boundary/falsifier, suppressed counteranalogy, Q14 uncommitted claim, Q35 authority gap, Q33 rights bypass, Q38 premature start, claim-ceiling overreach. a.aria-label: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 门禁：Q38-I1 fail-closed evidence-retrieval gate with stable exits 0 and 2-21. It blocks unaudited Q37 seeds, support-only search, negative deletion, duplicate-family counting, rights bypass, stale evidence, missing representativeness, quantity voting, similarity-to-mechanism promotion, stop-condition rewrite, selective exclusion, ceiling inflation, invalid provenance/digest, incomplete selection logs, missing Q39 exports, counterevidence override, temporal invalidity, unbounded search, dangling references, nonexistent repository sources, wrong Git objects, path escape, null/placeholder bindings and digests not computed from actual retrieved bytes.
a.title: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 门禁 — Q38-I1 fail-closed evidence-retrieval gate with stable exits 0 and 2-21. It blocks unaudited Q37 seeds, support-only search, negative deletion, duplicate-family counting, rights bypass, stale evidence, missing representativeness, quantity voting, similarity-to-mechanism promotion, stop-condition rewrite, selective exclusion, ceiling inflation, invalid provenance/digest, incomplete selection logs, missing Q39 exports, counterevidence override, temporal invalidity, unbounded search, dangling references, nonexistent repository sources, wrong Git objects, path escape, null/placeholder bindings and digests not computed from actual retrieved bytes.

text.tspan: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 门禁

a.aria-label: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 受控试点：Q38-I1 bounded real-repository replay: one traceable support item, counterexample, boundary case, negative result and deliberately unperformed external retrieval, all bound to the Q37 repair seed and actual repository bytes; 30 fixtures drive the real CLI. Negative and failed records export to Q39; external validity remains an explicit gap. No external fact, mechanism proof or real-world action is claimed.

text.tspan: 案例、反例与边界证据检索 受控试点

a.aria-label: 失败记忆与修复传播 合同：Q39-I1 typed append-only failure lineage across Q36 residual/rollback, Q37 mismatch/retraction and Q38 counterexample/negative/failed retrieval exports; binds origin task, artifact, exact head, digest, causal status, retry boundary, propagation and ceiling impact without proving cause.
a.title: 失败记忆与修复传播 合同 — Q39-I1 typed append-only failure lineage across Q36 residual/rollback, Q37 mismatch/retraction and Q38 counterexample/negative/failed retrieval exports; binds origin task, artifact, exact head, digest, causal status, retry boundary, propagation and ceiling impact without proving cause.

text.tspan: 失败记忆与修复传播 合同

a.aria-label: 失败记忆与修复传播 门禁：Q39-I1 deterministic fail-closed gate: rejects broken hash chains, silent overwrite/deletion, cause overclaim, unchanged retry, missing repair propagation, no downstream plan effect, retracted claims driving actions, environment-as-theory relabeling, lost negative results, broken source binding, invalid recurrence/closure, ceiling inflation, nonexistent propagation targets, wrong Git objects or actual-byte digests, fictional authority, unbound effects and boolean-only application claims. High-risk intervention effects remain request-only.
a.title: 失败记忆与修复传播 门禁 — Q39-I1 deterministic fail-closed gate: rejects broken hash chains, silent overwrite/deletion, cause overclaim, unchanged retry, missing repair propagation, no downstream plan effect, retracted claims driving actions, environment-as-theory relabeling, lost negative results, broken source binding, invalid recurrence/closure, ceiling inflation, nonexistent propagation targets, wrong Git objects or actual-byte digests, fictional authority, unbound effects and boolean-only application claims. High-risk intervention effects remain request-only.

text.tspan: 失败记忆与修复传播 门禁

a.aria-label: 失败记忆与修复传播 受控试点：Q39-I1 bounded repository pilot replays Q36 rollback, Q37 analogy mismatch and Q38 counterexample/negative/failed retrieval into an append-only chain with structured Git-bound downstream plan-effect records; 30 fixtures drive the real CLI. High-risk intervention remains request-only. No real-world retry or external action.

text.tspan: 失败记忆与修复传播 受控试点

a.aria-label: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 合同：SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repair-r1 contract with explicit repository reference records binding path, commit, blob, actual-byte SHA-256, record type, declared role and selected typed evidence object. Structured actor, meaning, power, face, distribution, counter-reading and material-evidence semantics replace caller-supplied pass booleans.
a.title: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 合同 — SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repair-r1 contract with explicit repository reference records binding path, commit, blob, actual-byte SHA-256, record type, declared role and selected typed evidence object. Structured actor, meaning, power, face, distribution, counter-reading and material-evidence semantics replace caller-supplied pass booleans.

a.aria-label: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 门禁：SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repair-r1 fail-closed CLI resolves local Git commits and tree entries, recomputes blob and SHA-256 integrity, checks actual object roles, and independently validates material objects, actors, meaning projections, allowed power modalities, distinct faces, benefit/cost distribution, counter-reading evidence, material downgrade, truth ceiling and causal ceiling with stable exits 0 and 2-20.
a.title: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 门禁 — SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repair-r1 fail-closed CLI resolves local Git commits and tree entries, recomputes blob and SHA-256 integrity, checks actual object roles, and independently validates material objects, actors, meaning projections, allowed power modalities, distinct faces, benefit/cost distribution, counter-reading evidence, material downgrade, truth ceiling and causal ceiling with stable exits 0 and 2-20.

a.aria-label: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 受控试点：SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repository-local synthetic pilot covering COMMUNITY_FOOTBALL_FIELD and SCHOOL_DATA_POLICY. Twenty repair fixtures use ordinary data-integrity names and exercise real Git reference resolution plus task semantics; original manifest fixture paths remain compatibility artifacts. No external action or truth/causal upgrade.
a.title: Symbolic Object, Power & Multi-Perspective Governance 受控试点 — SYMBOLIC-SPHERE-I1 repository-local synthetic pilot covering COMMUNITY_FOOTBALL_FIELD and SCHOOL_DATA_POLICY. a.aria-label: Principle Lock, Process Quality & Outcome-Bias Governance 合同：DECISION-INTEGRITY-I1 typed evidence-bound contract. Principles, assumptions, decision order, risks and stop conditions can be frozen ex ante so process quality and outcome quality remain separately auditable after results appear.

a.aria-label: 外部输入源：笔记、新闻、文章、案例、记忆、现实事件等可追溯外部材料。
a.title: 外部输入源 — 笔记、新闻、文章、案例、记忆、现实事件等可追溯外部材料。

a.aria-label: 点火增量输出源：claim、argument、mechanism、map、gap、residue、模型投影、分析与反馈返回项。
a.title: 点火增量输出源 — claim、argument、mechanism、map、gap、residue、模型投影、分析与反馈返回项。

a.aria-label: 写作素材池：同时接收外部输入与已登记的点火增量输出，保存来源类型和 claim ceiling。
a.title: 写作素材池 — 同时接收外部输入与已登记的点火增量输出，保存来源类型和 claim ceiling。

a.aria-label: 之元写作法 0.4.0 Current：以双来源素材池驱动 L6 心智层级跃迁与公共表达。
a.title: 之元写作法 0.4.0 Current — 以双来源素材池驱动 L6 心智层级跃迁与公共表达。

a.aria-label: Case source provenance：起始案例的公开来源链与版权边界。
a.title: Case source provenance — 起始案例的公开来源链与版权边界。

a.aria-label: Point-fire analysis：点火对案例生成的可追溯增量结构，也可进入写作素材池。
a.title: Point-fire analysis — 点火对案例生成的可追溯增量结构，也可进入写作素材池。

a.aria-label: Accepted work：经审查接受且保持来源与证据边界的公共作品。
a.title: Accepted work — 经审查接受且保持来源与证据边界的公共作品。

a.aria-label: 成果索引：人类可读的完整成果导航。
a.title: 成果索引 — 人类可读的完整成果导航。

a.aria-label: 成果 registry：机器可读的排序、路径、哈希、review 与 claim ceiling。
a.title: 成果 registry — 机器可读的排序、路径、哈希、review 与 claim ceiling。

a.aria-label: Public work / response：作品、读者响应、作者修订与现实反例。
a.title: Public work / response — 作品、读者响应、作者修订与现实反例。

a.aria-label: Provenance capture：登记主体、渠道、时间、原文范围、版本和解释限制。
a.title: Provenance capture — 登记主体、渠道、时间、原文范围、版本和解释限制。

a.aria-label: Candidate source / gap / reality feedback：合格反馈只成为候选来源、缺口或现实反馈，不直接升级真值。
a.title: Candidate source / gap / reality feedback — 合格反馈只成为候选来源、缺口或现实反馈，不直接升级真值。

a.aria-label: 返回 Q12 / Q13 / MCF / PSD / ARN / iteration：由适用组件决定下一行动并生成新的可追溯增量。
a.title: 返回 Q12 / Q13 / MCF / PSD / ARN / iteration — 由适用组件决定下一行动并生成新的可追溯增量。

a.aria-label: 不增加 L7：系统图和写作素材池都在现有 L0—L6 与 overlay 内工作。
a.title: 不增加 L7 — 系统图和写作素材池都在现有 L0—L6 与 overlay 内工作。

a.aria-label: 不自动升级真值：节点、连线、生成结果、测试与点击量都不能制造事实或因果。
a.title: 不自动升级真值 — 节点、连线、生成结果、测试与点击量都不能制造事实或因果。

a.aria-label: 不证明理论完整：完整图是当前导航投影，不是永久总图或理论完备性证明。
a.title: 不证明理论完整 — 完整图是当前导航投影，不是永久总图或理论完备性证明。
